verdict.rationale: The evidence never publishes Casium's own petition-preparation duration or the government processing times a case depends on. 'Clear deadlines you can count on' describes in-case task deadlines, not published expected timelines. The H-1B guide gives fixed lottery and start dates rather than processing-time estimates, and 'answers measured in minutes and hours' refers to support response time. These are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on
